verification.note: Historical repository extraction and sibling schema at 82218b4, not a current local factory implementation. Reviewed paper additions and exact versions live in references/papers-20261015/references/readset.md and docs/reference-matrix.md; no efficacy or paper-to-code equivalence established.

applicability.prerequisites: Current candidate inventory and source/evaluation evidence; historical sibling execution interfaces are not required for read-only artifact admission
applicability.input_contract: A candidate inventory plus the source and evaluation evidence for each candidate skill; read-only artifact admission needs no historical sibling execution interface
applicability.produced_artifact: An admitted or refused skill candidate with its source, evidence and limitation record, and its stable id and owning path
failure_modes: A candidate admitted on an inventory line without source or evaluation evidence
A stable id or path assigned twice across owners
Indexing or admission reported as validation or promotion
Paper-to-code equivalence asserted without a pinned readset
applicability.refusal_point: Refuses admission when a candidate has neither source evidence nor a declared evaluation state, and records the refusal instead of leaving the field blank

recommendations: Read the methodology counterexamples in references/papers-20261015/cases/ before admitting a candidate derived from a paper.
Keep the source snapshot revision as research evidence; it is not a campaign default.
Record an unvalidated candidate as candidate with not_run rather than omitting the state.
limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local efficacy validation.
searchspace_not_applicable: SKILL.md §§ Choose the evidence product, Artifact lifecycle, and What this skill does not do define skill-distillation/evaluation methodology; NPU task tiers are evaluation prerequisites, not a hardware-resource mechanism.
